examples.text: Podczas ostatniej sesji Rady Wydziału została poruszona kwestia otwarcia przewodów doktorskich.

examples.text: Na dzisiejszą sesję sądową wyznaczono dwie rozprawy i trzy posiedzenia.

glosses: powtarzający się cyklicznie okres, w którym odbywają się egzaminy

examples.text: Sesja egzaminacyjna wywołuje napady stresu i paniki u niejednego studenta.

glosses: spotkanie przeznaczone na robienie serii zdjęć

examples.text: Urządziliśmy sobie wiosenną sesję zdjęciową w parku.

glosses: An official meeting or term of a council, court, or other body to conduct its business; e.g. the annual or semiannual periods of a legislature (that together comprise the legislative term), whose individual meetings are also called sessions.

examples.text: This court is now in session.

glosses: The sequence of interactions between client and server, or between user and system; the period during which a user is logged in or connected.

examples.text: Logging out or shutting down the computer will end your session.

glosses: Any of the three scheduled two-hour playing sessions, from the start of play to lunch, from lunch to tea and from tea to the close of play.
The act of sitting, or the state of being seated.

examples.text: So much his ascension into heaven and his session at the right hand of God do import.
But Vivien, gathering somewhat of his mood, / And hearing 'harlot' mutter'd twice or thrice, / Leapt from her session on his lap, and stood, / Stiff as a viper frozen; […]

glosses: Ellipsis of jam session, used in isolate particularly for folk music.

examples.text: “I downloaded a clip from a drummer, who I now realize is Bernard Purdie, who has sessioned on all kinds of records,” he said.
